meta.title: Translation Utility
meta.description: Download translation files and verify community translations against the English base.

verifier.title: Translation Verifier
verifier.description: Upload a ZIP file containing translations to verify against the English base translations.
verifier.expectedStructure: Expected structure: Archive containing translation files matching the English structure

guide.title: How to Use the Translation Tool

download.title: Download Base Translations
download.body: Select a language below to download its translation files. These will serve as your template.

extract.title: Extract & Translate
extract.body: Extract the archive and locate the JSON files. For each translation entry, replace the text while keeping the keys unchanged.
extract.basicExample: "noLevels": "No new levels to announce" → "noLevels": "Your translated text here"
extract.placeholdersBody: Some translations contain {{open}}value{{close}} placeholders. These must be kept but can be repositioned:
extract.placeholderExample:
"welcome": "Welcome back, {{open}}username{{close}}!"
→ "welcome": "{{open}}username{{close}}, willkommen zurück!"

"progress": "{{open}}count{{close}} of {{open}}total{{close}} levels completed"
→ "progress": "{{open}}count{{close}} von {{open}}total{{close}} Level abgeschlossen"
extract.placeholderWarning: Never translate the placeholders themselves (e.g., {{open}}username{{close}}, {{open}}count{{close}}, etc.)

verify.title: Pack & Verify
verify.body: Pack your translated files into a new archive (.zip, .7z, .rar, etc.) and use the verifier above to check for any missing or incorrect translations.

submit.title: Review & Submit
submit.body: Check the verification results. If everything is marked as valid, your translation is ready to be submitted!
